title: Message send response
description: Answer of P1 msg.send: message id, entry state and number of recipients (for an all delivery the sender sees to how many workers a copy went, at most 50, MSG-14). Through P3 send_message the model gets only {staged: true} or a short "no" (PRM-8). A repeat by (tenant, sender, key) within the expiry returns the same answer.

state.description: staged for an attempt (publication at complete, MSG-9); current for the state genus.

recipients.description: Number of copy recipients for an all delivery.
